name: Yimutian Inc. American Depositary Shares
summary: Yimutian Inc., through its various subsidiaries, provides digital business-to-business (B2B) platforms that facilitate agricultural product transactions throughout the People's Republic of China. Its portfolio includes the Yimutian App, an e-commerce platform dedicated to agricultural B2B exchanges, and the Douniu App, an online wholesale marketplace designed to connect agricultural sellers and large-scale buyers for offline trade arrangements. Additionally, the company extends its offerings to encompass digital agricultural commerce, sourcing and trading services for farm produce, and a suite of other digital agricultural solutions. These solutions include expert consulting, brand promotion, and educational programs focused on digital agriculture. Yimutian also maintains direct involvement in the farming business. Established in 2011, Yimutian Inc. is headquartered in Haidian, China.
